name: Backyard Bug Explorer Pack
description: A bug-themed exploration pack for ages 8–10 featuring a 10-chapter backyard field adventure, a choose-your-path bug mystery, two profile frames, and two visual themes.

adventures.name: The Backyard Bug Expedition
adventures.description: Explore a parent-approved front yard, backyard, or similar outdoor space like a real field scientist while observing insects and other tiny creatures without harming them.

chapters.name: Chapter 1 — Build Your Bug Explorer Kit
chapters.description: With an adult, gather a notebook, pencil, water, and a magnifying glass if you have one. Review the rules: observe instead of touching, never taste plants or insects, avoid unknown spiders or stinging insects, and stay inside your approved exploration area.

chapters.name: Chapter 2 — Map the Expedition Zone
chapters.description: Walk the approved front or backyard and sketch a simple map. Mark grass, flowers, shrubs, trees, fences, rocks, garden beds, and other places where tiny creatures might live.

chapters.name: Chapter 3 — Grassland Safari
chapters.description: Study a patch of grass for several minutes. Look for ants, beetles, grasshoppers, flies, or other tiny movement. Record what you see and how each creature moves.

chapters.name: Chapter 4 — Leaf and Flower Patrol
chapters.description: Observe leaves and flowers without picking them. Look above and underneath leaves for insects, holes, eggs, webs, or other signs that bugs have visited.

chapters.name: Chapter 5 — The Ground Crew
chapters.description: Search the soil, pavement edges, and other safe ground-level areas. If an adult says it is safe to lift a loose object, look underneath without touching any creature and carefully return the object exactly where it was.

chapters.name: Chapter 6 — Wings in the Air
chapters.description: Watch for flying visitors such as butterflies, moths, bees, flies, or dragonflies. Observe from a safe distance and record where they land and what they seem to be doing.

chapters.name: Chapter 7 — Ant Highway Investigation
chapters.description: Find ants from a safe distance and watch their route. Do not block or disturb them. Sketch their path and see whether they are traveling alone or working together.

chapters.name: Chapter 8 — Web Watch
chapters.description: Search for spiderwebs without touching them or approaching spiders. Notice the web shape, location, and anything caught in it. Compare the web habitat with places where you found insects.

chapters.name: Chapter 9 — Habitat Detective
chapters.description: Choose two different areas from your map and compare them. Which had more bug activity? Consider shade, sunlight, plants, moisture, shelter, and food as possible reasons.

chapters.name: Chapter 10 — Backyard Bug Field Report
chapters.description: Finish your expedition by recording your three most interesting discoveries. Draw or describe one creature, identify its habitat, and share one new thing you learned with your family.

author: Family Quest Center

books.title: The Mystery of the Midnight Garden
books.description: Strange clues appear in the garden after sunset. Follow beetles, moths, ants, and glowing fireflies through a choose-your-path mystery about the tiny ecosystem just outside the door.
